verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that SendGrid's v3 Web API is built to send email at scale and handle high volumes. One community user reports sending 10M emails per month without issues. That implies high-throughput sending, but nothing in the pack documents an actual bulk or batch operation, such as many recipients per request or bulk management of contacts and resources. Missing for 10: documented batch or multi-recipient send semantics, bulk contact or list operations, bulk update or delete endpoints, and hands-on evidence of bulk operations driven by an agent.
